Column guide: "value" is the latest survey value and "year" its survey year. "previous_value" and
"previous_year" are the survey before it, and "change" is value minus previous_value. A column ending in
"average" is the simple average of the latest values of the countries in that group. A column named after a country
is that country's latest value, and the column ending in "year" beside it is its survey year. A column
starting "gap vs" is value minus that comparator. "region_rank" is the country's position among
"region_countries" countries in its own region, where 1 is the highest value. "obstacle_rank" ranks the
biggest-obstacle indicators within the country, where 1 is the obstacle firms name most often. "flags" are
notes produced by simple rules. Empty cells mean no data.

TASK: Read every line. Choose the 4 most interesting points for a reader who knows the region. Prefer values far from the comparators, large changes since the previous survey, and above all pairs of indicators that tell a story together or seem to contradict each other. Cover at least three different topics.

RULES:
- Use only numbers that appear in DATA, written exactly as they appear or rounded to a whole number.
  Do not calculate any new number.
- Describe what the data show. Do not claim causes.
- If a change looks too large to be plausible between two survey rounds, say in "verify" what should be
  checked. Otherwise set "verify" to an empty string.
- Plain English. Each "text" is at most 45 words. Do not put indicator codes in the text.

Return only JSON: a list of objects with the keys "headline" (at most 8 words), "text",
"indicators" (the list of indicator codes the point uses) and "verify".

checks.headline: Political instability emerges as top business constraint
Rising financing barriers and high loan rejections
Strong management practices contrast with collapsing innovation
Severe water and internet disruptions burden firms

points_used.headline: Political instability emerges as top business constraint
points_used.text: Political instability surged to Ethiopia's leading obstacle, cited by 32.3% of firms in 2025 compared to 0.4% in 2015, ranking highest across Sub-Saharan Africa. Concurrently, firms reported sharp contraction, with real annual sales growth falling from 0.2% to -11.7%.

points_used.headline: Rising financing barriers and high loan rejections
points_used.text: Access to finance is identified as a major constraint by 56.8% of firms, up from 20.3% in 2015. Additionally, 21.6% of recent loan applications were rejected—exceeding the regional average of 7.8%—while 59.4% cited unfavorable terms as the reason for not applying.

points_used.headline: Strong management practices contrast with collapsing innovation
points_used.text: Ethiopian medium and large firms scored 61.4 on the management practices index, ranking fourth in the region. However, process innovation among these firms dropped from 58.4% in 2015 to 6.0% in 2025, falling well below the Sub-Saharan Africa average of 19.9%.
points_used.verify: Check whether the survey question wording or sampling criteria for process innovation in medium and large firms changed between 2015 and 2025.

points_used.headline: Severe water and internet disruptions burden firms
points_used.text: A majority of firms (52.4%) experience water insufficiencies, more than double the Sub-Saharan Africa average of 24.7%, averaging 12.0 disruptions per month. Furthermore, 60.1% of enterprises report internet disruptions, compared to the regional benchmark of 43.9%.
